name: bld_sqrt_two_rec_viete_tendsto
statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, a (i + 1) / 2) Filter.atTop (nhds (2 / Real.pi))
closed: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)), Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, a (i + 1) / 2) Filter.atTop (nhds (2 / Real.pi))
informal: Uses Mathlib2.ana_sqrt_two_rec_closed_form (and the finite product identity derived from it): the partial products equal 1/(2^n sin(π/2^(n+1))), and 2^n sin(π/2^(n+1)) → π/2 since sin t / t → 1. This is Viète's formula 2/π = (√2/2)(√(2+√2)/2)⋯.
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ), a 0 = 0 → (∀ (n : ℕ), a (n + 1) = √(2 + a n)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, a (i + 1) / 2) Filter.atTop (nhds (2 / Real.pi))
